jobs.description: Silver refresh of the 건축인허가 층별개요 lane `building-permit-floor-overview` (root ADR-0169 ②, ADR-0402): pick the newest complete hub.go.kr release in the Bronze ledger and, unless silver.building_permit_floor_overview already records it or a newer one (`unchanged`), export it, stage it on a load branch, compare it with the table's current rows key bucket by key bucket and append to main only the changed floors' rows and a removal marker per vanished floor (lane contract compare.content_columns; root ADR-0318), and read it back (`changed`). Started when a source_sweep run lands new files, and daily as the fallback (root ADR-0171). One lane runs at a time: each takes the compose `spark` cap.

first_run.estimated_from: computed, about 2.5x the nearest larger measured neighbours on the same template unit (root ADR-0386): silver_refresh_building_permit_basis_outline 357 s for a 438 MB release, _parking 251 s for 59 MB, _demolition_loss 161 s for 15 MB; this lane's newest release is about 429 MB in the Bronze ledger (2026-11-09)

assets.title: 건축인허가 층별개요
assets.description: 허가된 건물의 층마다 한 행: 층구분(지하·지상·옥탑)·층번호·층면적, 층의 주용도·구조, 건축구분. 공장·창고 동의 층별 쓰임과 면적을 말하고 관리동별개요PK·관리허가대장PK 로 동별개요·기본개요에 붙는다. 원문 24칸 보존. 필지 by-PNU 종류 parcel-building-permits 가 행의 PNU 로 필지 문서의 목록 하나로 싣는다(루트 ADR-0402, ADR-0464).

dependencies.description: 건축인허가 층별개요(mart_kcy_03) 24칸을 관리층별개요PK 마다 바뀐 층만 append-only Silver 로 쌓는다(루트 ADR-0402).
dependencies.pnu_resolution: pnu composed at Silver by the Rust hub/VWorld export (export-*-silver-handoff, standard_pnu_from_hub_register_codes / ADR-0145), not a raw provider code; HUB 대지구분 2 (블록) composes none (FP-ADR-0023); merged, split or recoded parcels are carried to the current pnu by the consumer through the place-identity resolver and views.changed_codes (ADR-0288, ADR-0329, ADR-0402)
